new_statements.rule_in_words: Stress (and tone) are stated to be non-contrastive in Petats; the authors give no rule for where stress falls. The single phonetically stress-marked form in the paper (a reduplicated disyllable) carries the stress mark on the first syllable, which is not enough to infer a rule.
new_statements.domain_note: Word-level phonemic analysis of a 1000-word corpus of the central (Petats proper) dialect; no discussion of phrase prosody or citation-form effects.
new_statements.identity_note: Allen & Beaso 1975 describe the central dialect ('Petats proper', West Buka); they name two other dialects, Pororan and Matsungan, which are not treated. Glottolog peta1245 = Petats [pex], no dialect-level codes involved.
